en-US.name: video-use
en-US.summary: Cut, caption and render video with the DesireCore-maintained Browser Use fork. Local word-level transcription is the default and downloads pinned models on first use. Requires Python 3.12, uv, ffmpeg and ffprobe. Optional ElevenLabs Scribe requires explicit selection, upload approval and your own API key. Service charges may apply.

zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.summary: 基于 Browser Use 的 DesireCore 维护版，支持剪辑、字幕和渲染。默认本地词级转写，首次运行下载固定版本的模型。需要 Python 3.12、uv、ffmpeg 和 ffprobe。可手动选择 ElevenLabs Scribe，需确认所选音轨的上传并自备 API 密钥，服务可能另行收费。

requirements.value: Python 3.12, uv, ffmpeg and ffprobe. The first local run sets up locked dependencies and downloads pinned public model assets. Local transcription runs on the machine holding the media and needs about 4 GB for English model weights.

Model downloads use Hugging Face and GitHub Releases. ElevenLabs Scribe is optional and runs only when explicitly selected. Upload requires approval of the chosen media and track, an operator-provided ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, and access to api.elevenlabs.io. The provider's terms, privacy policy and possible fees apply.
